values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; same-day campsite reservations until 3 pm on the day of arrival, and walk-ins are permitted on campsites. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away before registering again. The registering camper must be 18+.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/chenango-valley-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=44 (Booking Window: Campsite 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; 'Same-day reservations are allowed until 3 p.m. on day of arrival ... Walk-ins are permitted on campsites only'; LENGTH OF STAY), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Only some sites have electric: of 118 campsites listed, 34 have 30 A and 22 have 50 A. No site has water; spigots are near every site.

hookups.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/chenango-valley-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=44 ('A small number of campsites offer electric. Water is NOT available on any campsite.') + ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 44 ('Electric Hookup available: 50 amp' on 22, '30 amp' on 34, '- no' on 62), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Six loops (Sunrise, Pine Bluff, Chipmunk 1-4). Of 118 campsites listed, equipment lengths run 20-50 ft (26 at 50 ft, 53 at 40 ft), all back-in.

sites.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/chenango-valley-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=44 ('Campsite (182)') + ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 44 (Equip length/Driveway '50 Back-In' 26, '40 Back-In' 53, '30 Back-In' 35, '20 Back-In' 4), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/chenango-valley-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=44 (Facilities: '... a playground, and showers. There are water outlets convenient to all campsites.'; Services and Amenities: Dump Station, Showers), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed reservable on ReserveAmerica and the 2027 season (May 14-Oct 10; Chipmunk 4, Pine Bluff and Sunrise to Sep 5). Added 9-month window, same-day/walk-in rule, 14-night max, 50 A on some sites with no water at any site, 182 sites to 50 ft (back-in), showers, dump, spigots. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. AWH note kept. Not stated: a minimum stay, sewer, pull-throughs.
